lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region. Centroids maintain relatively consistent spatial intervals along the horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, high-reflectance feature is visible inferior to the primary lateral pattern, posterior to the pectoral fin trailing edge.
